fix.change: Require type(inFlightToolCount) is int before accepting its value as zero.
fix.rationale: Python bool is a subclass of int, so False == 0 previously admitted malformed public state. The strict exact-type guard accepts the bridge's JSON integer zero but rejects booleans and non-integer values before any delivery attempt is created.

checks.before_fix_summary: 14 tests; 13 passed and the independent inFlightToolCount=False malformed-state case incorrectly returned OMP_PROCESSED.
checks.after_fix_summary: 14 bridge tests, including all 4 independent regressions. Malformed state defers without creating an attempt; the same message can proceed after readiness recovers.
